description: Entries the collector does not call in a partition, because the service or the endpoint that serves them is not offered there (req-aws-collector-partition-7). An entry names a whole service (service) or one entity type (entity_type); a service is listed whole only when none of its entries is served. Each carries why, how it was established (ran, web, read or inferred), the evidence and the date. tools/validate/tests/test_partition_availability.py keeps this file consistent with the newest wave 0 record (req-aws-collector-partition-10).
